notes.title: Mathbits v1.1 (July 2025)
notes.content: [h3]Improvements & Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Matrixbit UX: You can now press [b]Enter to rewrite your answer[/b] quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where "Enter to rewrite answer" would flash unnecessarily after correcting a wrong answer.[/p][/*][*][p]Critical bug fix: Leaderboards now update and display correctly in all game modes. (If your leaderboard score was incorrectly updated for a mode, play the mode for 2 rounds and your highest score should upload correctly)[/p][/*][*][p]Clarified that [b]"Rank" = Global Rank[/b] in all leaderboard screens.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Matrix Square Mode: New challenge mode added to Matrixbit.[/p][/*][*][p]When ending a Matrixbit game, your last submitted answer is now shown.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: First Patch Release! (July 2025)
notes.content: [p]Hi! Thanks to those who bought and tried the game right on release day. Here's the first set of patches:  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Removed the initial flash of graphs in Graphbit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the correct answer display inside Solvebit modes (e.g. Time mode) [/p][/*][*][p]Invert "Find trigonometry functions" with "Find quadratic functions" inside Graphbit[/p][/*][*][p]Fix LSD Cats & Secret Number achievement inside game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I expect to push 1-2 updates each month starting from now, so feel free to leave your suggestions below![/p]

notes.title: MATHBITS — OUT NOW ON STEAM
notes.content: [p]After months of late-night coding sessions, endless puzzle testing, and rewriting our game engine more times than we’d like to admit, we’re excited to finally launch [b]Mathbits[/b].[/p][p]What started as a simple idea—to make math genuinely fun—has grown into a full-featured challenge engine with over 50 unique mini-games. These aren’t just exercises in disguise. They’re fast, challenging, and designed to keep you hooked while building real math skills.[/p][h3]How it started[/h3][p]We asked ourselves: what if practicing calculus, memory, algebra, and graph reading felt more like playing an arcade game than doing homework? No drills. No worksheets. Just pure gameplay.[/p][p]That idea became [b]Mathbits[/b]—a collection of rapid-fire games across seven core modes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Membit[/b] – Test your memory with numbers, IBANs, and other tricky codes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guessbit[/b] – A smarter take on the classic number guessing game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Seriesbit[/b] – Spot patterns in primes, Fibonacci numbers, and more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Solvebit[/b] – Arithmetic, logic, and algebra under time pressure.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphbit[/b] – Identify graphs, match equations, and complete missing data.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Calcubit[/b] – Take on derivatives (including second-order) at speed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Matrixbit[/b] – Perform real matrix operations quickly… or try to.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Key Features[/h3][list][*][p]Over 10 challenges per category—and more planned[/p][/*][*][p]Optional game modifiers like Time Attack, LSD mode, and Cats[/p][/*][*][p]Global leaderboards for every challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Detailed personal stats and progress tracking[/p][/*][*][p]Built-in memory trainer (because yes, some challenges are that hard)[/p][/*][*][p]Created by a small team who love both math and games[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re preparing for school competitions, brushing up for exams, or just enjoy a fast-paced challenge, Mathbits offers a unique blend of fun and focus. It's designed to be:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fast[/b] – Quick restarts, no waiting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flexible[/b] – Welcoming for beginners, challenging for experts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rewarding[/b] – Skill and progress matter more than grind.[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669500/Mathbits/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]💬 We'd love to hear your feedback, challenge ideas, or math memes in the community hub![/p]
